_comment: Victory-Dance self-play run config. Pass with: python -m v_dance.selfplay.generation --config config.json  (--config alone implies a live run). Every section overrides defaults; an explicit CLI flag still beats the file. Delete any section/key you don't want to change. 'generation' keys are CLI flag names with dashes->underscores (--format is 'battle_format'). Unknown sections/keys fail loud. The values below are a 'push past the plateau' preset (more exploration + a steadier signal + a bigger actor step); defaults shown in _defaults.
_defaults: generation: games=100(wizard 300) tau=1.0 tau_start=1.3 tau_anneal_gens=12 kl_coef=0.5 mirror_battles=360 | ppo: entropy_coef=0.01 clip_eps=0.2 value_coef=0.5 | train: actor_lr=3e-5 critic_lr=1e-3 ppo_epochs=4 minibatch_size=256 | gate: promote_threshold=0.55
